question:
Five friends P, Q, R, S, and T live in a five-storeyed building numbered from 1 (lowest floor) to 5 (top most floor). Each of them lives on different floor of the building.

R lives on the floor below Q's floor. T does not live on the top floor. There are equal number of people living above and below the floor on which S lives. Two people live between the floors where T and R live. Q does not live immediately above or below the floor where S lives. Who lives on second floor?
